description: The plot illustrates how Macro-F1 Score (%) varies with the number of tokens for two methods, “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information,” with shaded bands around each line indicating variability. The x-axis is labeled “Number of tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.5 to 1.5 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%),” uses a linear scale, and shows tick labels from 48 to 56 in steps of 2 (48, 50, 52, 54, 56), with the plotted values extending slightly above 56. The pink line for “MATTER (ours)” uses circular markers and a solid line; it starts near 55.1 at 0.5 tokens, dips to about 54.3 at 0.7, rises to about 57.0 at 0.8, reaches a higher point around 58.0 at 1.0, then declines to about 53.0 at 1.2 and ends near 50.9 at 1.5, with a small rise around 1.4 (about 53.5). The purple line for “w/o material information” also uses circular markers and a solid line; it begins around 52.5 at 0.5, increases to about 54.1 at 0.7, then gradually decreases through roughly 53.3 at 0.8–0.9 and about 52.9 at 1.0, continues down to about 51.7 at 1.3, rises to about 53.3 at 1.4, and then drops sharply to about 47.9 at 1.5.
